# Directional blur

Smears the image along one direction, like a fast camera pan or a streak of speed.

<EffectDemo effect="directional-blur" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { directionalBlur } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/directional-blur';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(directionalBlur({ preset: 'pan' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.angle = 0`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type    | Default | Range      | Description                                         |
| --------- | ------- | ------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `angle`   | number  | `0`     | 0 – 180 °  | Direction of the smear; 0 is horizontal.            |
| `length`  | number  | `24`    | 0 – 200 px | Length of the smear in pixels.                      |
| `samples` | integer | `24`    | 4 – 64     | Samples per pixel; more are smoother and cost more. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                     |
| ---------- | ---------------------------- |
| `pan`      | `length: 60`, `samples: 32`  |
| `vertical` | `angle: 90`, `length: 40`    |
| `diagonal` | `angle: 35`, `length: 32`    |
| `whip`     | `length: 140`, `samples: 48` |

Apply one with `directionalBlur({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Blur & glow · tracked as story X5.6 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.8 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/directional-blur`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Linear box blur along an angle, with per-pixel jitter.

## Related

- [Radial & zoom blur](./radial-blur) — Blurs toward or around a center point: a zoom burst that rushes at the viewer, or a spin like a rotating camera.
- [Motion blur](./motion-blur) — Blurs moving objects and camera motion along their path, as a camera shutter does.
- [Blur](./blur) — Blurs the whole frame with a separable Gaussian, a box filter, or iterated Kawase passes, optionally at reduced resolution for wide, cheap blurs.
